evidence: CatalogueService.addProduct checks for a duplicate ID through the injected ProductRepository, builds the product with the domain factory Product.create(command), saves it with this.products.save, and returns product.snapshot(). This is use-case orchestration.
CatalogueService.listProducts and getProduct only read through the repository port and map results to ProductSnapshot. getProduct throws the domain NotFoundError when a product is missing.
AddProductCommand is a plain input command object, which is typical for an application layer.
The file contains no HTTP, framework, database or serialization code. Graph edges show the infrastructure files http.ts and server.ts using this service, not the other way round.
